name: BSP_PressStartScreen_Construct
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_title_init, read-only analysis. __thiscall, ECX = an 18h allocation, returns it in EAX, RET. Chains BSP_FrontEndScreen_Construct 004f7180, clears +14h and byte +14h+1 (param_1[4] and byte at +5 of the derived part) and stores vtable 00CF6D90. Sole caller recovered: 0068d92f inside the title-screen vtable +4h (0068d8d0), which stores the result at title+40h, runs its virtual +10h, marks it wanted and active, calls BSP_FrontEndScreen_CommitVisibility and finally its virtual +18h. The .rdata literals immediately after vtable 00CF6D90 are FE_initial, press_start_Text, globals.saving_xbox, wide Session and FE.unitlib_toggledesc, so this is the press-start screen: the title screen first interactive state. docs/GAME_TITLE_INIT.md | Correction to the field list above: the body clears the dword at +10h and the byte at +14h, then stores the vtable. Read from the decompile of 0067c840 (param_1 is undefined4*, so param_1[4] is +10h and (byte*)(param_1+5) is +14h).

name: BSP_Game_IsSignInStateValid
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_title_init, read-only analysis. No arguments, result in AL, RET. Returns true only when DAT_00E19880 is non-zero, 00a3e510 reports a signed-in user, and BSP_XenonSystemManager_FindSlotForInvitee (00a3e470) equals BSP_XenonSystemManager_GetActiveUserSlot (00a3eac0). Sole use recovered here: GGame::OnInitTitle at 004c9c31 runs BSP_XenonSystemManager_ResetSignInState (00a40020, ECX = [00F8ABE8]) and 0067c970 when it is false. docs/GAME_TITLE_INIT.md

name: BSP_Game_RebindPrimaryInput
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_title_init, read-only analysis. No arguments, void, RET. Takes the first element of the checked vector at [00F8BBF4]+B8h (the same vector BSP_SoundRequestQueue_ApplyPending polls), passes it to 00a90ee0 when it is non-null, then calls 00a917e0(2, 1, 0), the input-slot bring-up BSP_Game_OnInitOnce runs for slots 0, 1 and 2, and sets DAT_00E1987C = 1. The interleaved 00bf6713 calls are _SECURE_SCL assertions. Reached from GGame::OnInitTitle at 004c9c45 only when BSP_Game_IsSignInStateValid is false. docs/GAME_TITLE_INIT.md

name: BSP_PressStartScreen_LoadLayout
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_title_init, read-only analysis. __thiscall, ECX = the 18h press-start screen, no stack arguments, RET, SEH handler 00C7CF78. Slot +10h of vtable 00CF6D90, which docs/GAME_FRONTEND_STATES.md identifies as the registry register slot. Calls BSP_FrontEndScreen_Register (004f71d0), then builds the pooled native string FE_initial (10 bytes) and passes it to BSP_GuiManager_GetOrCreate()->00aa5840(&name, 1, 0), storing the returned GUI layout handle at screen+8h. This is the only GUI layout the title screen loads beyond FE_frame and FE_frame_title. docs/GAME_TITLE_INIT.md
